texts.name: Step Title 1
texts.content: You pay and complete the intake.

texts.name: Step Body 1
texts.content: A short form: your CV, your portfolio link, what you're looking for, and what you'd rather avoid. It takes about 15 minutes to fill out properly.

texts.name: Step Body 2
texts.content: Manual research against your actual profile and goals — not a keyword filter or an automated feed.

texts.name: Step Body 3
texts.content: Counted from a complete intake. If something in your intake is unclear, I'll ask before I start, and the clock starts once we're aligned.

notes.whoItsForLayout: SoT layout=vertical stacks Who For Col + Who Not Col (each width 520). Column widths imply intended side-by-side; Forge should verify against desktop-full.png / ce-mid-who.png — refs show constrained two-column feel.
notes.includedMotion: Included Stack layout=none, 920×544. Three cards 520×440 at x=200, y=0/32/64 (stacked with 32px Y offsets). Motion note frame (pink #FFF5F8) instructs Forge: scroll-pinned enter one-by-one; rest=aligned stack like incredibles.dev.
notes.mobileMotion: M Included Stack 335×920; cards 300×320 at x=18, y=0/24/48.
notes.faqAnswers: Only one answer authored in SoT (open row: What if the roles aren't a good fit?). Other FAQ rows are closed (+) with no answer text in the pen — copy must come from product brief or be added later.
notes.footerColumnTitles: Footer fill=#FFFFFF but Col Tit text fill=#FFFFFF (invisible on white). Foot Brand/Copy use #8A8A8A. Flag: likely dark footer intended or titles should be dark — check desktop-full.png.
notes.mobileGaps: Mobile SoT has no Proof/About section and no multi-column Footer; M Close has copyright line + Close Panel only. No M Pricing intake microcopy.
notes.mPriceCtaLabelFill: M PCTA text fill is #656565 on #111111 button — likely SoT bug; desktop Price CTA label is #FFFFFF.
notes.shadows: No effects/shadows on Desktop or Mobile product frames.
